headline: Marban Hollow Toll Soars as Nevish Line Grinds On
war_summary: Marban Hollow has registered no base action since the last edition, the final entry coming at 18:25, yet its casualty bill has grown into the war's heaviest, recent losses running past a thousand Colonial and fifteen hundred Warden an hour, with one of its eight posts now rubble and seven in Colonial hands. The Nevish Line remains the busiest field: fifty actions in the day, fourteen within six hours, the latest filed five minutes before press time, leaving six posts Warden-held, one Colonial and one demolished; Blackcoat Way, Grief Mother and Princefal drew the heaviest traffic. The Weathered Expanse logged twenty-three actions, Warden losses climbing toward six hundred an hour, its balance standing five Colonial, three Warden, one wrecked. Palantine Berm counted forty-seven actions, fifteen inside two hours, Leiri Hermanni the storm's eye, all seven posts still Warden-held. Kuura Strand, idle since mid-afternoon, closed its day at 1,231 Colonial and 981 Warden casualties. Callahan's Passage saw no base action since late morning even as losses ran near five hundred an hour a side. It is day 485; thirty-four victory towns decide the war, and no victor is named.
